mapper.sql: FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id
mapper.select:
SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN '정상' THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN '관심' THEN 'INTEREST' WHEN '주의' THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN '경고' THEN 'WARNING' END AS riskGrade, pr.risk_grade AS riskGradeName, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, pr.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.llm_model AS llmModel, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion
ORDER BY pr.predicted_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.input_hash AS inputHash, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, pr.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.llm_model AS llmModel, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.llm_error_message AS llmErrorMessage, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE pr.prediction_id = #{predictionId}

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.input_hash AS inputHash, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, pr.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.llm_model AS llmModel, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.llm_error_message AS llmErrorMessage, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE fs.customer_id = #{customerId} AND fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} ORDER BY pr.predicted_at DESC, pr.prediction_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT feature_snapshot_id AS featureSnapshotId, customer_id AS customerId, base_ym AS baseYm, feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, CAST(features AS CHAR) AS features FROM feature_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym IN (#{baseYm}, #{previousBaseYm}) ORDER BY base_ym DESC

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.input_hash AS inputHash, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, pr.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.llm_model AS llmModel, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.llm_error_message AS llmErrorMessage, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE pr.input_hash = #{inputHash} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prediction_result ( feature_snapshot_id, input_hash, model_version, feature_schema_version, hazard_1m, hazard_2m, hazard_3m, cumulative_risk_3m, risk_grade, percentile, reasons, explanation, recommendation, llm_status, llm_model, prompt_version, llm_error_message, predicted_at ) VALUES ( #{featureSnapshotId}, #{inputHash}, #{modelVersion}, #{featureSchemaVersion}, #{hazard1m}, #{hazard2m}, #{hazard3m}, #{cumulativeRisk3m}, #{riskGradeName}, #{percentile}, CAST(#{reasons} AS JSON), #{explanation}, NULL, #{llmStatus}, #{llmModel}, #{promptVersion}, #{llmErrorMessage}, #{predictedAt} )
